newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan children find drugs on beach - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan children find drugs on beach - newspaper.

text.p: Children playing on a Moroccan beach opened the plastic bag they found and tasted the white powder inside -- 30 kg (66 pounds) of a hard drug believed to be cocaine, the daily l'Opinion newspaper said on Wednesday.
Police, alerted to the find, checked the beach on Tuesday and found two more similar bags, a total of 90 kg (198 pounds). The newspaper said police were still analysing the haul.
